name: ui-file-tree
description: FileTree — UI factory (1:1 with the @almadar/ui file-tree pattern).

schema.name: ui-file-tree
schema.description: FileTree — UI factory (1:1 with the @almadar/ui file-tree pattern).

emits.description: Called when a file is clicked

events.name: @config.on file select
events.description: Called when a file is clicked

indent.label: Indent
indent.description: Indent size per level in px (default: 16)

items.label: Items
items.description: Flat node list, nested by `parentId` at render time — takes precedence over `tree` when provided. A `parentId` with no matching row renders that node as a root rather than dropping it.

nodeActionIcon.label: Node Action Icon
nodeActionIcon.description: Icon for the row hover action (default: plus).

onNodeAction.label: On Node Action
onNodeAction.description: Called from the row's hover action button, in flat `items` mode; carries that node's id. Presence-gated: binding it renders the action.

selectedId.label: Selected Id
selectedId.description: Currently selected node id, in flat `items` mode: the row highlights and every ancestor auto-expands so the selection is always visible — the 'you are here' a navigation tree needs.

onNodeSelect.label: On Node Select
onNodeSelect.description: Called when a node is clicked, in flat `items` mode; carries the selected node's id. Presence-gated: binding this prop is what turns on the click-to-select affordance, mirroring Badge's `onRemove`.

look.label: Look
look.description: Visual treatment for flat `items` mode: `files` (default) keeps the monospace file-browser look; `nav` renders a sidebar navigation tree — regular font, document icons, roomier hit areas.

tree.label: Tree
tree.description: The tree data (pre-nested). Ignored when `items` is provided.

onFileSelect.label: On File Select
onFileSelect.description: Called when a file is clicked

nodeActionLabel.label: Node Action Label
nodeActionLabel.description: Accessible label/tooltip for the row hover action.
